resources.string: Clear all data of \"%1$s\"? Settings, sign-in and files of the app will be deleted.
This device has no app info page
This is a system app, it cannot be uninstalled
Background processes of %1$s stopped (connect ADB for a full stop)
This app has no accessibility or notification service
How much the system may limit this app in the background
Sources: F-Droid, IzzyOnDroid, GitHub, GitLab, Aptoide (APKPure: optional). The signature of a new APK is compared with the installed one before installing.
GitHub token (optional: removes the request limit)
The update is signed differently from the installed app: not installed (protection against a fake)
No build for this device processor
The update needs a newer Android
The downloaded file is not newer than the installed app
“Update all” needs root or ADB (installs without prompts)
Runs in the background on a schedule, the network is used only then. Found updates are shown as a notification and in the header.
Only with root or ADB. The signature is checked, skipped apps are left alone. Off: only a notification.
Tap to turn a source on or off. A fragile source uses an unofficial API and may stop working.
With root, ADB and a computer are not needed: allow root for this app in Magisk. The switch picks what is used at start.

Stop, cache, data, permissions and battery need ADB debugging on this device.\nAndroid 11 and newer: Settings → Developer options → Wireless debugging → \"Pair device with pairing code\": enter the pairing port and code here, press \"Pair\".\nAndroid 10 and older or head units: turn on ADB over network (port 5555) and press \"ADB over network\".
Launcher mode is off by default. Turning it on sets this app as the home screen (without ADB the system asks: “Always”). “Turn off” returns the old launcher.
No app to pick a picture on this device
Or put a PNG named %2$s.png into the folder %1$s
Batch replace: a folder or ZIP of pictures named after the package or app.
They will be removed silently through ADB.
Without ADB the system will ask to confirm each app, one after another.
Pick a folder with APKs or an archive (ZIP, 7z, RAR, TAR) and tick what to install. Split packages (APKS, XAPK) install as one app.
They will be installed silently through ADB.
Without ADB the system asks to confirm each app.
Move the icon with the arrows (touch: tap the new place). OK or \"Done\" finishes. The order is remembered.
The copy has settings, icon order, hidden apps and own icons (no ADB key). It is also saved on every exit.
Save copy in the program folder
Prepares the list and icons in the background and re-enables accessibility services after boot.
First Home press shows the menu, the second opens the home screen chosen here.
Do not turn on again after boot
Done: the Home button now opens this menu
ADB is off: in the list that appears choose this app and press \"Always\"
After a launched app is closed (Back)
Return to the native home screen
Choose in the built-in file manager...
Choose a folder with apps or an archive
No access to files. Connect ADB (Settings) so the program can grant itself the right, or allow it in the system settings.
Find and install from the internet...
Search works in open catalogs: F-Droid (free software) and GitHub releases. You can also paste a direct link to an APK. Install only what you trust.
Found: %1$d. Press an app to download and install it.
This project has no APK file in its latest release
Confirm the installation in the system window
ADB is not connected: connect it in Settings. Flash drives that the system does not show are read through ADB.
Shared folders of computers, routers and NAS in your network (Windows sharing, SMB). Find them or enter the address. For open folders leave the name empty.
Nothing with shared folders found yet
Receive files over Wi-Fi (from a phone or computer)...
On your phone or computer in the same network open this address in a browser, choose APK files or archives and press \"Send\". While this window is open, the device accepts files.
No local network found. Connect the device to Wi-Fi or a cable, or turn on a hotspot on the phone and connect the device to it.
Remote: OK opens, hold OK or Menu shows actions. Touch: tap opens, long tap shows actions. Mouse: left button opens, right shows actions.
The folder is empty. Press \"Add icons\" or drag an icon onto another icon.
Before an app is deleted its APK is saved, any version can be restored. Data is not saved.
No copies yet. They appear when you delete an app or roll it back.
Pick any saved version, a version from F-Droid or your own APK file. Going to an older version keeps app data when the system allows it; the current version is saved first.
No saved copies of this app yet
This app is not in F-Droid
Going to an older version needs ADB: connect it in Settings
This is not a usable APK file
The file belongs to another app: %1$s
No access to device storage for OBB files: connect ADB in Settings

On Android 10 and older there is no wireless debugging. Once, connect the phone to a computer with a USB cable (USB debugging on) and run: adb tcpip 5555. This window connects by itself as soon as it works.

1. Press the button below. 2. Turn on \"Wireless debugging\" and choose \"Pair device with pairing code\". 3. Pull down the notifications and type the 6-digit code in the \"App Menu\" notification. That is all: the port is found automatically.
Pairing window found (port %1$d): enter the code in the notification
Open \"Pair device with pairing code\" in the settings and type the 6-digit code here
The code has 6 digits: type it again
The pairing window is not open: choose \"Pair device with pairing code\" and type the code again
Wrong code or the window was closed: type the code again
Paired, but not connected yet: wait a few seconds or press \"Connect\"
Reads the pairing code in the system settings window and connects ADB by itself. Works only while you press \"Connect automatically\" in the app.

Fully automatic: turn on the \"App Menu\" service in Accessibility once (the button below), then press \"Connect automatically\": the program opens the settings, turns on wireless debugging and types the code by itself.
Or by hand: open \"Wireless debugging\" (code in a notification)
Stop, cache, data, permissions and battery need ADB debugging on this device. Android 10 and older or a car head unit: turn on ADB over network (port 5555) and press \"ADB over network\".

Iron mode: the built-in home screens, which the firmware starts first and does not let you stop, are switched off for your user. After that the home key and the boot lead only here. Needs ADB or root. You can undo it with the big button below; the commands to undo it from a computer are also saved in the file tvapps_home_restore.txt on the device.
Iron mode: switch off the built-in home screen
Will be switched off: %1$s. Press the button once more within 15 seconds to confirm.
Done: the built-in home screen is off, the home key leads here.
The built-in home screen is back.
Iron mode is ON. Switched off: %1$s
ADB or root is not connected: connect it above first.
No other home screen found, nothing to switch off.
Could not switch it off (%1$s). Everything stays as it was.
Not everything was restored: connect ADB or root and press again.
Protection worked: the app restarted too often, so the built-in home screen was returned.
If the app does not open: from a computer run the commands from the file tvapps_home_restore.txt, or in Android settings open Apps, show system apps and enable the disabled launcher.
Voice input is not available on this device
Could not turn on channels: connect ADB or root, or allow \"TV listings\" in the app permissions
City for the weather card (empty: no card)
These accessibility services can intercept the Home key and conflict with the home screen: %1$s
Add apps to Favourites: long press an icon in All apps and choose the star. Set a city for the weather in Settings.
Apps will appear here by themselves. Press OK to change the row.
No cards. Press OK to choose what to show.
To read app channels give the \"TV listings\" permission: connect ADB or root in the menu settings, then open this list again.
Empty: the place is found automatically from the internet
Searching the catalogs of installed apps…
Nothing found in the catalogs of installed apps
Nothing launched yet: apps opened from the menu or Home will appear here
Access is turned on automatically with root or ADB; otherwise allow it in the system settings.
No HDMI inputs found on this device
OK switches the TV to the input
Bind another remote button to voice search…
Press the button on the remote
The button you press will open voice search. Arrows and OK cannot be used. Back cancels.
Auto: hidden on TV and boxes, shown on phone
No rows. Press OK or long-press to add a row or open settings
The choice is remembered for the microphone button of the remote. It can be changed in Screen settings.
Empty: the name of the app
Empty: no name and no gap above the row
Apps in the row (OK adds or removes)
No HDMI inputs found on this device
No channels found. Turn on app channels first.
Picture, video and animation are copied into the app; a picture goes into the backup, video and animation do not (they are big).
This copy was changed and signed not by us: some functions are off (ADB, root, install).
No widgets found on this device
If the system does not allow it, connect ADB or root in the menu settings and choose the widget again.
The widget was not added: the system did not allow it. Connect ADB or root in the menu settings.
No HDMI inputs found on this device. They appear on TVs and boxes with HDMI inputs.
Reset the Home layout to default
Press again: rows, top bar and background will be reset
Press again: only the app menu will remain
Home is a separate screen with rows and widgets. When off, only the app menu works.
Could not turn Home off: first restore the native home screen (connect ADB or root, then the RESTORE button in the iron mode block).
Home and the menu cannot both be turned off: turn on the menu first
Home and the menu cannot both be turned off: turn on Home first
There are no other rows of icons
No banner for %1$d app(s) on Home
Create nice banners from the app icon? The style can be changed later: press and hold OK on a tile, Look, Create a banner.
Cards are the results of this search in the app, e.g. movies, news, music.
No cards for this query. Press OK to change the query.
Empty so far. Hold OK on any card, then \"Add to favourites\". Opened cards appear in the history.
Wrap tiles onto the next line
Press again to delete the widget (the place stays empty)
Simpler icons for car head units and weak boxes: no reorder animation while scrolling, no hover and ripple, static background gradient. Auto turns it on for head units.
Icon cache cleared, icons are being redrawn
Dense: many icons on dark plates, columns and rows from the screen size (1280x720: 13 x 4). Auto turns it on for car head units. Size and columns/rows below still change it.

Off: the menu remembers the focused icon and scroll when you return from settings, windows, folders or an app, and starts from the beginning after exit with Back. On: the position is kept after exit too.
On return to the menu with the Home key, background apps are stopped quietly, at most once per 20 seconds. An app that plays sound or video is not stopped. Off by default.
Marked apps are never stopped. Keyboards, accessibility services, remote control, VPN, ADB-phon and voice assistants are always protected.
Empty: add apps through the card → To desk…
Off: the app grid does not start and uses no memory; the Home screen stays. The Menu button disappears from Home; search still opens the menu for a moment. Turn it back on here.
Which home screens to turn off: highlighted ones are turned off, the rest stay on (you can switch between them). By default only built-in system ones are highlighted.
